subject: world_language
concept: Using simple location words (in, on, under) to describe where something is
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student places objects in different physical positions while saying the location word in the target language
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a location word to the correct picture showing that spatial relationship
exercise.abstract: Student describes where a pictured object is using a target-language location word

misconception_flags: confuses similar location words (in/on) in the target language

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
